profile.name: Cytomat 自动化微板培养箱/存储系统
profile.description: Cytomat 是面向实验室自动化的微孔板培养与存储设备，提供温度、CO2、O2 与湿度等环境控制，配有内部摇床、条码读取与对接传送口。设备可在存储位、等待位、传送位及外部曝光位之间自动搬运微板，支持门控与铲式传送机构操作，适用于细胞培养、微生物培养及高通量筛选中的板级培养与中转存储。
profile.description_en: Cytomat is an automated microplate incubator and storage system providing controlled temperature, CO2, O2, and humidity. It integrates internal shakers, barcode reading, and a robotic transfer station, moving plates between storage, wait, transfer, and exposed (external) positions with door control and a shovel-type transport mechanism. It is used for cell culture, microbial culture, and high-throughput screening for plate incubation and intermediate storage.
